key_insight: HADRec improves medication recommendation by combining patient EHR information with drug molecular knowledge and by respecting the ATC drug hierarchy.
clinical_relevance: This could support safer, more accurate drug suggestions with more clinically meaningful reasoning and better confidence calibration.
method: Encodes clinical notes with LLaMA-7B and drug SMILES with ChemBERTa
Fuses patient and drug features using cross-attention
Adds a hierarchical predictor plus consistency loss to enforce ATC structure
evidence_signal: The model achieved state-of-the-art results on MIMIC-III, generalized well to MIMIC-IV, and showed strong calibration (ECE = 0.04, Brier = 0.06).
watch_item: Performance depends on high-quality EHR text and reliable molecular/ATC mappings, so real-world deployment would need careful validation across institutions.
paper_title: HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record
